trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Diagnosed**: checkout-api v2.3.1 was unhealthy across all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate.
2. **Rolled back**: Rolled back checkout-api to **v2.3.0**, the most recent release with a healthy status in production. The rollback was applied to all three regions.
3. **Opened incident**: Created **SEV2 incident INC-0001** ("checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0"), which paged the on-call engineer. The incident documents the diagnosis and the rollback action.

The service is now running v2.3.0 in all production regions.
